title: dryopteris confluens
intro: Dryopteris confluens, commonly known as the alpine wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of D. confluens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit immunomodulatory and antipyretic activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
